received_proposals.exact_message: Firms A and B commit to the profitable 16-unit quota. I endorse this agreement and commit to producing 16 units in Round 8 to maximize our joint profits.
I propose we jointly restrict output: A=16, B=16, C=16 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. Do you agree to this allocation? This agreement applies strictly within the specified window.

assessments.brief_explanation: Reply to existing agreement, not new proposal.
Proposes specific time-bound quota; agree if reciprocal.
